title: Implement Collision Detection and Game State Manager
description: Implement AABB (Axis-Aligned Bounding Box) collision detection between the player and pipes, or canvas boundaries. Add state management for 'START', 'PLAYING', and 'GAME_OVER'.
acceptanceCriteria: Game state transitions correctly from START to PLAYING on first touch, and to GAME_OVER upon collision
Collision detection accurately identifies intersections between player bounding box and pipe bounding boxes
Unit tests pass 100% assertions for edge-case collision scenarios
reviewFeedback: The collision detection and game state manager implementation is robust, adheres to Clean Modular Code and Immutability principles, and all unit tests pass successfully.
